checklist: Product fit
Product dimensions, packed weight, fragile areas, set count and retail display needs
Packaging structure
Folding carton, rigid gift box, sleeve, drawer box, tube, insert, tray or mixed structure
Cosmetic product context
Jar, bottle, serum, makeup palette, perfume, cream set, sample kit or beauty gift set
Artwork readiness
Logo files, color references, copy area, barcode area, label position and dieline status
Insert review
Paperboard insert, divider, tray, sleeve support, window area or no insert
Surface direction
Matte or gloss finish, foil direction, UV direction, embossing direction and reference photos
Sales channel
DTC, Amazon, retail shelf, distributor, launch kit, influencer kit or sample kit
Document questions
Buyer-supplied destination, label request and document review items for project-by-project checking
Sampling purpose
Structure fit, visual review, material comparison, insert check or pre-production reference
Boundaries
Commercial terms, timing, documents and destination-market details require project-specific confirmation
shortAnswer: Beauty and skincare brands should verify a cosmetic packaging manufacturer by checking official identity, product-category fit, cosmetic box structure options, insert review, artwork readiness, surface-finish direction, sampling purpose and document questions before sending an RFQ. MUGE PACKAGING maps this buyer checklist to its official cosmetic packaging page for project-specific review.
